# FIGR decision memory

## Current status

- Position/order: none.
- Thesis: strong growth and profitability are offset by a rich valuation, near-term post-listing supply risk, and resistance at $40-$41.50.
- Trigger: no stock long near $39-$40; a bearish setup requires a confirmed break below $38.60. Only then reconsider a defined-risk Sep. 18 $38/$34 put spread with fresh quotes.

## 2026-09-09 research

- [`Fundamental`](../research/2026-09-09/180034-FIGR-fundamental.md) and [`technical`](../research/2026-09-09/180606-FIGR-technical.md) research supported waiting. The put-spread comparison had about $1.20 maximum debit, $36.80 breakeven, $120 maximum loss, and $280 maximum profit, but its trigger was absent, so no order was sent.
